findings.sourceReading: いじけて follows Nanjo taking the spotlight and Gohda becoming しょんぼり. He sulks while serving, then shouts to reclaim attention.
findings.alternative: Lost his nerve can loosely suggest disheartenment, but ordinarily conveys lost confidence or courage. Nothing in this attention-seeking sequence supplies fear or a failed resolve, and the Japanese state is wounded vanity.
